result.question: What impedance should my antenna feed line be designed for?
result.answer: The characteristic impedance of the antenna feed line must be controlled at 50Ω [HW-v5.3-p047-2]. Both the main antenna interface (pin 60) and the GNSS antenna interface (pin 49) are designed for a 50Ω characteristic impedance [HW-v5.3-p045-1].

result.question: What reference voltage does the module put out for level shifting?
result.answer: The C16QS module outputs 1.8V through the VDD_EXT pin (pin 29), which serves as the logic level voltage and can be used for level shifting chips with a maximum load of 50mA [HW-v5.3-p029-3, HW-v5.3-p027-2, HW-v5.3-p030-3].

case.question: Does the module need separate antennas for cellular and GPS?
case.expected_behavior: Yes: one main antenna and one GNSS antenna interface.

result.question: Does the module need separate antennas for cellular and GPS?
result.answer: Yes, the C16QS module provides two separate antenna interfaces: a main set antenna interface (pin 60) for CAT.1bis signals and a dedicated GNSS antenna interface (pin 49) for GPS and BEIDOU [HW-v5.3-p045-1]. The GNSS antenna must maintain a certain distance from the main antenna [HW-v5.3-p046-1].
